text: With named owners in place, this lesson labels the personal data itself -- Confidential PII, applied exactly where Purview's scanners actually found it.
Social Security numbers, email, phone, and date of birth in the SQL database. Contact fields in Salesforce. The warehouse's own blended customer attributes.
Each label traces back to a real classifier result, column by column, across every one of the four sources registered and scanned back in Lesson 8.
We ran a coverage audit against the classification export and confirmed zero unlabeled columns -- everything in scope is deliberately reviewed.
Customer PII across every scanned system now carries an enforceable label. Next: proving exactly where one number on the executive dashboard actually comes from.
